oneLine: Jio Platforms is reported to set an IPO price band with listing expected in October.

sources.title: Jio Platforms said to set IPO price band, listing likely in October

synopsis: Jio Platforms is planning an initial public offering to raise roughly ₹30,200 crore at an implied valuation of up to ₹10.3 lakh crore. The company is set to price its shares at ₹1,065 to ₹1,119 apiece, offering up to 270 million new shares representing about 2.93% of its post-issue equity capital. Public subscription is planned to open on 21 October and close on 23 October, with the anchor book scheduled for 19 October and shares expected to begin trading on 28 October. The offering is the telecom and digital services arm of Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Industries Ltd. Nineteen banks have been appointed to work on the share sale, including Kotak Mahindra Capital, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, Axis Capital, BNP Paribas, and Citigroup.
